description: Cloudflare global data-centre outage on 21 June 2022 is provided by Cloudflare. Cloudflare describes a 21 June 2022 outage affecting 19 data centres after a network-configuration change. The report gives an outage start of 06:27 UTC, initial restoration at 06:58 and restoration across those sites by 07:42. Geographic context: global. Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. The public source page provides documentation and links for obtaining the resource; no data or software archive was downloaded. The cited material was readable without payment. The affected sites handled unequal traffic, so site counts do not directly indicate the share of users affected.
